title: NB-03 revision 2 (rear yard on a short block, ZR 23-344(b)/(c)(3)): gaps a-h answered, and the ZR 12-10 'street', 'street setback line', 'street, wide' and 'street, narrow' definitions captured (documents only)
objective: Revise docs/research/evidence-records/NB-03-rear-yard-short-block.json to revision 2, answering gaps a-h of work order v2 (M5-T163): (a) the depth conflict 99.97 (gis), 100 (printed_tax_map) and ~101.06 (derived) shown as a conflict with no basis chosen; (b) the shared short-dimension test also used by 23-363(c), one measure; (c) captures of ZR 12-10 'street' and 'street setback line' through the print/PDF channel or the disclosed fallback, sha256-pinned, stating which features bound a block and what the tax map's ALLEY means for (b); (d) a method for irregular blocks, or 'searched, not found'; (e) the R4B neighbours and any district-boundary yard rule; (f) record (do not fix) the stale register entry and the rule's limitation text; (g) no worked example yet (M5-T176 supplies it); (h) MapPLUTO LotFront/LotDepth meaning on a corner lot and their basis, or 'searched, not found'. If the channel works, also capture 12-10 'street, wide' and 'street, narrow' (NB-06 records them later, in M5-T170). Each capture lands in docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/ in the existing zr-12-10-* shape and as a byte-identical bundled copy in services/api/app/_zr_snapshots/v1/. W24 owner of the README status cells and the RESEARCH_REQUESTS.md index line (G-13). A defined term that does not exist in 12-10 is reported, not invented.
